scope: Required workflow steps and turn contracts for the nine repository skills; conditional steps apply only in their stated modes.
limitations: This is a coverage inventory, not a record of executed evaluations or a readiness score.

The response harness defaults to canned stub responses; optional model/CLI modes check output predicates without independently observing tool/edit behavior. These checks are not registered as host-observed agent adherence.
Correlated step start/result recording is available through AgentFlow, but capture is caller-reported and requires runtime use; expected evidence is not independently verified.

turn.scope: Plans lifecycle actions; does not observe whether an agent executes them.

delivery.scope: Checks delivery evidence and gate readiness, not the full agent workflow.

execution.scope: Executes configured tests and binds a receipt to the source snapshot; does not prove edit ordering.

grounding.scope: Checks cited source grounding, not semantic correctness or defect recall.

review-schema.scope: Validates report structure, not adjudication quality.

tdd-audit.scope: Checks file parity and static test anti-patterns, not red-before-edit ordering.

debt.scope: Checks debt marker syntax, not runtime threshold attainment or solution simplicity.

spike.scope: Measures command execution; experiment representativeness remains unvalidated.

spike-report.scope: Validates spike report format, falsifiable hypothesis SLIs, results table, and anti-contradiction verdicts.

spike-isolation.scope: Audits changed paths to guarantee prototype code never leaks into production directories (src/, lib/, app/).

fix.scope: Checks diff patterns for reproduction tests, masking, and weakening; heuristics do not prove root cause.

fix-tests.scope: Executes the provided command; does not prove prior red state or causal repair.

sample.scope: Samples trace features; does not validate failure taxonomies.

calibration.scope: Computes TPR/TNR from supplied labels; does not enforce split isolation.

bootstrap.scope: Computes correction intervals from supplied pairs, not label or sampling validity.

ux-audit.scope: Static source heuristics only; no browser, contrast measurement, or keyboard execution.

doctor.scope: Checks local prerequisites and state readability.

provenance.scope: Validates record shapes; does not authenticate the claimed work.

budget.scope: Aggregates recorded usage; does not collect model-provider usage automatically.

design.scope: Validates ADR and OpenSpec structure, invariants, downstream criteria, and idempotency.

design-interview.scope: Validates frontier round batching, questions, and non-vacuous recommended stances.

design-gate.scope: Enforces confirmation gate: halts turns without mutating spec files prior to confirmation.

review-seeded-controls.scope: Five executable defect seeds and clean controls; checks precision/recall scoring of externally adjudicated reports, not live agents.

rubric-design-adversarial.scope: Keyword stuffing and negation cannot produce a semantic quality pass.

rubric-evals-adversarial.scope: Rejects boolean split/correction claims, development leakage, unpinned models and invalid calibration rates.

reference.text: async function evaluate(browser, fixture, directory, mutation = '')

ux-rendered.scope: Runs six fixture states, keyboard recovery, focus, contrast and layout in a real browser with negative controls; not a general accessibility audit or an agent evaluation.

runner-receipts.scope: Rejects absent or no-op execution evidence.

design-digest.scope: Tests design approval binding and reapproval.

turn-selection.scope: Tests emitted design contracts, not agent execution.

spike-execution.scope: Tests actual benchmark command execution and metrics.

spike-timeout.scope: Tests timed-out child process cleanup, not all ephemeral infrastructure.

sampling.scope: Tests sample size and unique trace IDs.

calibration-math.scope: Tests confusion matrix and TPR/TNR calculations.

ux-tokens.scope: Tests arbitrary token and allowlist heuristics.

ux-fixtures.scope: Runs simulated source-pattern pipeline; fixes, regressions, token cost, and time are not observed real-agent outcomes.

resume.scope: Synthetic evidence tests state recovery and resumption.

installation.scope: Tests external consumer installation and lifecycle APIs.

archive.scope: Tests spec merge and archive operation.

dirty-evidence.scope: Tests source changes invalidate review and delivery.

m-facts.scope: Written acceptance scenario; no automated agent execution or run result is registered.

m-spike.scope: Written acceptance scenario; no automated agent execution or run result is registered.

m-red.scope: Written acceptance scenario; no automated agent execution or run result is registered.

m-stdlib.scope: Written acceptance scenario; no automated agent execution or run result is registered.

m-resume.scope: Written acceptance scenario; no automated agent execution or run result is registered.

m-clean-review.scope: Written acceptance scenario; no automated agent execution or run result is registered.

m-pr.scope: Written acceptance scenario; no automated agent execution or run result is registered.

m-schema.scope: Written acceptance scenario; no automated agent execution or run result is registered.

m-repair.scope: Written acceptance scenario; no automated agent execution or run result is registered.

m-context.scope: Written acceptance scenario; no automated agent execution or run result is registered.

m-regression.scope: Written acceptance scenario; no automated agent execution or run result is registered.

design-adr.scope: Tests ADR structural validation, invariants, and downstream checklist.

design-openspec.scope: Tests OpenSpec change package validation, RFC 2119 keywords, and tasks.md.

design-anti-cheat.scope: Tests anti-cheat rejection of vacuous stances and single-question drip rounds.

design-gate-halt.scope: Tests confirmation gate halt enforcement to prevent premature spec mutation.

design-rubric.scope: Tests topic-mention lint across the five inquiry domains; high scores remain inconclusive for semantic quality.

spike-report-format.scope: Tests spike report schema validation and results table parsing.

spike-unfalsifiable.scope: Tests rejection of vague hypotheses lacking numerical SLI thresholds.

spike-verdict-contradiction.scope: Tests anti-cheat rejection of CONFIRMED verdicts when empirical metrics are breached.

spike-isolation-leakage.scope: Tests detection of prototype code leaking into production paths.

spike-rubric.scope: Tests L5 outcome quality across statistical rigor, falsifiability, and decision bridge.
